text:
[quiet, close to the microphone, calm and unhurried, a man talking across a kitchen table late at night] — your light was on. I hope that's all right. I won't stay long.

[precise, patient, slightly pleased with his own clarity] I want to explain how I keep things. Then it'll make sense.

I'd had some of those windows open since March. February, some of them. Three of them were the same note... I closed two.

Everything goes side by side now. Nothing on top of anything. Mail went to two. The browser went to three. I went back to make sure. They were still there. There's a bar along the bottom, so you always know where everything is.

I made a rule. Chatter opens on two. [a small pause] I did read both messages.

I gave Mark his drill back. Four years. It's a better drill than mine, actually. He said I didn't need to.

Four is the house. Five is the street. Nobody else wanted to take the minutes.

[cooler, very even] Your hedge is six foot two. The limit is six feet. We've talked about it... twice. I've photographed it every morning since. A hundred and sixty mornings.

I sent the minutes round again. You're the only one who replied.

[colder, quieter, never louder] There was a photograph attached. It took me a minute to recognise the study. [pause] From this side.

[exhales] Can I sit? ...I'll sit.

[a long silence, then flat and soft] Leave it on.

captions.open: Interview resumed, 22:40. In your own time.

A.note: Restrained but unmistakable. No. 14 makes a faint “hm” after the odd phrase. He closed two of the three who signed the note, Mark “has a place”, and the sheets are down. Ends on “Leave it on.”

B.note: Explicit. He hears the odd phrase and corrects it. He names both of them (Sixteen in March, Mark in June) and where they are, says it won't take long, then “Somebody should take the minutes.”

C.note: As far as it goes (the film is cut to this one). A breath of a private laugh after the odd phrase. Everything in B, then the tape keeps running through it, and he reads the minutes: “Present... one.”
